parts.text: The first reference photo sets the sculpting style, clay finish, lighting and camera framing. The second reference photo is the character: keep the exact same face sculpt and head proportions. Change only what this description says: Photograph of a hand-sculpted stop-motion claymation figure, matte plasticine with fingerprints, tool marks and pressed texture, soft studio lighting, highly detailed, in exactly the style of the reference photos. A grotesque disfigured old man with an oversized bobble head, mottled skin with age spots, small sunken bloodshot eyes in swollen red-rimmed lids, a large ear with a fat hanging lobe, thick neck, hunched broad shoulders, head turned three-quarters toward the viewer's right. Head type: a huge tall lumpy dome skull with dents and bumps, like the master reference, pink flesh-toned clay skin, a dirty, worn plain beige trucker cap with a mesh back, completely blank with no logo, signatures or writing, messy grey hair sticking out at the sides. No mask: a weathered wrinkled face with huge round bulging staring eyes in baggy lids, a big nose and a scraggly grey-brown beard and moustache. Wearing a dad-style khaki collector's vest with lots of pockets, covered in rows of small round blank enamel pin badges in bright colours (plain dots and stars, no pictures, no lettering), over a plain faded grey T-shirt with no lettering or print; he looks like a man in his mid fifties, in his left hand he holds out a round cracked bone-white clay orb shaped like a goalie mask rolled into a ball, covered in rows of small breathing holes with rusty rivets and dried blood; it is all one off-white colour, with no red half, no band and no button; his right fist grips a gleaming solid-gold axe with a golden head and a dark wooden handle, held low at his side. A plain textured terracotta-orange pressed clay backdrop. FACING: exactly like the first reference photo, his body is in three-quarter view and his head and face are turned about 45 degrees toward the RIGHT side of the image (the viewer's right), nose pointing right; never turned to the left side and never straight on. Three-quarter view from the hips up, whole head, mask and weapons inside the frame with a little space above the head, figure centred, square 1:1 composition. SCALE (the same for every figure in the series): the figure is the same size in the frame as in the first reference photo, the bobble head the same size relative to the body, and weapons true to scale with the hands, never oversized or tiny. Both hands are full: the orb held out in one hand toward the viewer, the hatchet gripped in the other. Avoid: text, logo, letters, watermark, brand marks, sports team logo, red chevrons or triangles on the mask, full-face goalie mask covering the forehead and eyes, white screaming ghost mask, black hooded robe, pins in a grid, extra fingers, deformed hands, cropped head, photo of a real person, cartoon outline, flat 2D, face turned to the left, mirrored pose, long finger blades, clawed glove with four long knives, red and green striped sweater, brown fedora, red and white ball, ball with a centre button, writing on clothes, logo on cap
